summary: Integrate Core-owned stopped snapshot admission and bounded background dispatch through the existing durable command journal; acceptance remains open.

guide.reason: Documents the development host API, durable acceptance, scoped status, exact retry and unresolved-outcome behavior without claiming completed UI or native acceptance.

api.reason: Authenticated host-local snapshot requests enter agent.Run for durable admission and execute independently of Controller. Existing Command/Result and owner peer contracts gain stopped snapshot metadata and exact settlement; API and machine references are updated in the coordinated contract slice.

roadmap.reason: Implements part of the existing recovery plan; no phase is closed.

state.record: Core state.json command journal retains accepted request IDs and outcomes. The executing Core managed journal owns native intent and capture detail; the master pool-vms.json owns snapshot descriptors and pending reservations. Fresh Controllers adopt the master inventory and owner-reported operation outcomes.
state.reason: Snapshot execution and durable acceptance survive Controller outage and replacement.

verification.method: Focused admission, dispatch, rehome, replay and ownership checks passed. Full agent/protocol race tests passed (agent 54.605s); Controller tests passed (35.872s), including catalog adoption and operation-ID collision regressions; localcore tests passed (7.985s, simulated agent channel). Final vmhost tests passed (9.768s) and race tests passed (14.352s), including symmetric memory/currentMemory normalization. Independent scoped reviews cleared authority, dispatch and validator corrections. Actual disposable host-API evidence covers durable acceptance, exact retry, changed-input conflict, stopped two-disk capture, exact master settlement, Core restart and replay with Controller offline, then fresh inventory/adoption by the same Controller. Earlier failed attempts are preserved in the linked QA record. The 14 focused runner tests passed after readiness/reporting corrections. A subsequent full `go test ./...` passed (agent 14.758s, Controller 35.822s, localcore 8.743s, vmhost 9.719s). Full Python suite passed (494 tests, one skip, 51.754s). Generated API references and repository privacy passed; the documentation gate passed for 139 uncommitted paths. A fresh Controller adopted the same pool/host/snapshot and succeeded operation; its original runner failed after enrollment, and an identity-bound read-only continuation was independently reviewed. The linked QA distinguishes its curated receipt from raw transcripts and records the missing old-Controller fingerprint baseline. Wider native matrix, multi-host replacement, browser workflow and phase acceptance remain open.
